page_content.our_story:
OUR STORY
Empowering Education for the Future

Established with a commitment to academic excellence and practical learning, Balmiki LincolnCollege has grown to become a center for innovation, research, and holistic education. From humble beginnings, we’ve evolved into a dynamic institution recognized for preparing graduates who make a global impact.

2000: Founding

Founded with a mission to transform education in Nepal through global partnerships.

2008: International Partnership

Launched our first international undergraduate program with Lincoln University College, Malaysia.

2016: Academic Expansion

Expanded academic offerings with new programs in technology and management fields.

2024: National Recognition

Ranked among Nepal’s leading colleges for international-standard higher education.

page_content.program_overview:
Program Overview

The Bachelor of Business Administration (Hons) (BBA.Hons) program at Balmiki Lincoln College, affiliated with Lincoln University College, Malaysia, is a comprehensive undergraduate degree designed to equip students with a strong foundation in business principles, management practices, and entrepreneurial skills. Our curriculum prepares graduates for diverse roles across various industries.

This four-year program blends theoretical knowledge with practical application, emphasizing critical thinking, problem-solving, and leadership development. Students gain insights into key business functions such as marketing, finance, human resources, and operations, ensuring they are well-prepared for entry-level management positions or further postgraduate studies. This globally recognized degree ensures you are ready for both local and international career opportunities.

Affiliation

This program is proudly affiliated with Lincoln University College, Malaysia, a reputable institution known for its commitment to academic excellence and industry-focused education. This affiliation ensures our students receive a high-quality, internationally benchmarked curriculum and a degree that is respected globally.

page_content.admission_requirement:
Admission Requirements

Prospective students for the Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) program must meet the following criteria to ensure their readiness for our rigorous academic environment:

Academic Qualification:
Completion of 10+2 or equivalent with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks (or a minimum GPA of 2.0 on a 4.0 scale) in any discipline, preferably Management or Commerce streams.
English Proficiency:
Demonstrated proficiency in English (e.g., a good score in IELTS/TOEFL if not from an English-medium academic background, or equivalent college assessment).
Entrance Examination:
Successful completion of the college's entrance examination, which may cover Mathematics, English, and General Knowledge.
Interview:
A successful interview with the college's admissions committee.

For detailed information on admission procedures, required documents, and application deadlines, please visit our Admissions page or contact our admissions office.

page_content.admission_requirement:
Admission Requirements

Prospective students for the Master of Business Administration (MBA) program must meet the following criteria to ensure their readiness for our rigorous academic environment:

Academic Qualification:
Completion of a Bachelor's degree (minimum 3-4 years duration) from a recognized university, with a strong academic record (e.g., minimum 50% aggregate marks or GPA 2.5 on a 4.0 scale).
Work Experience (Preferred):
While not always mandatory, candidates with a minimum of 1-2 years of relevant professional work experience are often given preference.
Entrance Examination:
Successful completion of the college's MBA entrance examination, which may cover quantitative aptitude, logical reasoning, verbal ability, and general awareness. (Alternatively, a valid GMAT/GRE score might be accepted, please confirm with admissions).
English Proficiency:
Demonstrated proficiency in English (e.g., a good score in IELTS/TOEFL if not from an English-medium academic background, or equivalent college assessment).
Letters of Recommendation:
Two (2) letters of recommendation, preferably one from an academic referee and one from a professional referee.
Statement of Purpose (SOP):
A well-written essay articulating your career goals, reasons for pursuing an MBA, and why you choose Balmiki Lincoln College.
Interview:
A successful interview with the college's admissions committee to assess your motivation, leadership potential, and communication skills.

For detailed information on admission procedures, required documents, and application deadlines, please visit our Admissions page or contact our admissions office.

page_content.Library:
Central Library
Extensive Resources & Study Spaces

At Balmiki Lincoln College, the library is the lifeblood of our academic community. It stands as a quiet and motivating space for research, study, and intellectual pursuit. We have carefully provided many resources, from a robust collection of books and journals to periodicals and academic databases, that cover each of the subjects taught at the college. The library provides our students with the necessary tools to be successful in their coursework, dive into in-depth research, and explore their particular interests outside of class.

The library has been designed to be a welcoming and comfortable place for everyone. There are many study places and options, from individual study carrels for intense studying to large tables for group work. We provide high-speed access to the internet as well as computer terminals that our students can use to [digital] access resources and conduct online research. Our librarians can also assist with looking up the collection, provide research strategies, and assist students with finding the information they are seeking. The Balmiki Lincoln College library is more than just a collection of books - it is a powerful center for learning and a quiet place of sanctuary for academic freedom.
